description: Finds who owns a US property from its street address, given as full_address or as street, city, state and zip. Returns the property details; with contact_audience=owners it also returns the owners with their names, phones (with DNC flags) and emails. Contacts are left out unless contact_audience is set. Needs a connected DealMachine account with paid access. A matched property costs one property credit and returned contacts cost people credits; nothing is charged when no property matches.

contact_audience.description: `none` returns property-only data with zero people credits; other values include matching contacts

fields.description: DealMachine property field IDs to include in results

full_address.description: Complete address string (e.g. "123 Main St, Austin, TX 78701"), as an alternative to the parsed address fields

street.description: Street address component only (e.g. "123 Main St"); separate city, state, and ZIP fields are available

name: dealmachine_enrich_address
